policy: Expected-result-first mapping: full when the current Playwright test proves the official Zephyr Expected Result through the intended business path; partial when the final expected state or a required path element is only partly proven. Test Data notes and operational guidance are supporting instructions, not extra pass criteria unless they are required to reach the Expected Result.

SAM-24962.test: MX QST 15 - Login via Home Page
SAM-24962.notes: Registered user session is verified on the MX storefront and the user lands successfully on the authenticated storefront/home context.

SAM-24971.test: MX QST 06 + QST 07 + QST 08 - Add product and validate Cart
SAM-24971.notes: Cart, SKU and order summary are validated, but the official Expected Result requires the cart UI to display SKU name, item price, thumbnail, available services, order summary, info icons and footer; those are not all asserted.

SAM-24981.notes: Samsung Care+ is selected and reflected in cart, but the current automation does not yet prove the official BC/PDP entry path end-to-end. The WMC/PreQA note is treated as supporting setup, not an additional pass criterion.

SAM-24982.notes: Trade-in UI is opened and validated, but the current test does not prove the official final state that trade-up was actually added on the cart page.

SAM-24988.notes: A controlled cart proceeds through the checkout button and proves the official Expected Result: navigation from cart to checkout.

SAM-24994.notes: A new guest shipping address is accepted through payment navigation, but the official Expected Result requires entering both new shipping and billing addresses for the registered-user scenario.

SAM-25002.notes: Registered Base Store user reaches payment, selects/fills credit card, submits once and creates the order successfully, satisfying the official Expected Result. Clearsale/approval guidance is conditional operational Test Data and is not treated as an additional pass criterion when the order completes successfully.

SAM-25011.test: MX QST 19 - See exact order status
SAM-25011.notes: The automation searches and opens an exact order in BackOffice, but the official Expected Result explicitly requires order/product search through basic/advanced search, which is not fully covered.

extraAutomation.scope: Order fulfillment / controlled S1 cron flow
extraAutomation.notes: Useful business-flow automation, but not mapped to SAM-25011 because the official MX Backoffice TC is a search-validation case.
